Maharashtra has EAPs (Emergency Action Plans) for only 65 of its 2,713 dams, Madhya Pradesh for 33 of 1,370, and Rajasthan for 164 of 313. This slow pace of safety measures for large dams raises concerns about infrastructure and environmental risks in the country.
articles.raw_summary: The state-wise data has further shown the wide disparities among the states. Maharashtra, which has the highest number of specified dams (2,713), has EAPs for only 65 dams. Madhya Pradesh has prepared EAPs for just 33 of its 1,370 specified dams. Rajasthan has completed 164 EAPs for its 313 specified dams. This shows the slow pace of safety preparedness concerning large dams in the country.

articles.title: 70-yr-old dispute finally settled; SC says 1950 is line that decides who owns Gurugram common land
articles.summary: The Supreme Court settled a 70-year-old dispute over common land in Gurugram (Haiderpur), ruling that the 1950 land records determine ownership. The top court restored a 1955 mutation of 436 bighas to the Gram Panchayat Wazirabad (now MCG), stating that private claims on common land must be proven with pre-1950 partition evidence. The ruling clarifies that common land cannot be treated as private property without such proof.
